main: Craving chicken but it's too hot for samgyetang? This refreshing cold chicken noodle soup delivers all the flavor of chogye-tang in just 3 minutes, no cooking chicken required! It's bright, tangy, and incredibly easy to slurp down when your appetite is low.
reply1:
Here's what you'll need for one serving:
• 1 can (drained) chicken breast
• 300ml cold water + ice
• 2 Tbs apple vinegar
• 1 Tbs soy sauce
• ½ Tbs mustard (yeon-gyeojja)
• 1 Tbs allulose
• Pinch of salt
• Handful shredded cucumber & cabbage
• Somyeon (thin wheat noodles)
reply2: Dissolve vinegar, soy sauce, mustard, and allulose in cold water for the broth. Adjust salt last, after balancing the sourness.
alt_text: Korean cold chicken noodle soup, chogye guksu, in a white bowl. It features shredded chicken breast, cucumber and cabbage strips, a clear icy broth with ice cubes, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds, captured in bright summer light.
